title: Samp and beans (Zambian cracked maize with beans)

ingredients.name: samp (dried cracked maize kernels; coarse hominy or cracked corn is a substitute)
dried sugar beans or kidney beans, soaked overnight

steps: Rinse the samp and the soaked, drained beans and put both in a large heavy pot with the water.
Bring to the boil, then lower the heat, cover and simmer for about 1.5 to 2 hours, topping up with hot water whenever the pot looks dry, until the samp and beans are both tender.
While they simmer, heat the oil in a frying pan and soften the onion for about 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and the curry powder, if using, and cook for 8 minutes until it forms a thick, glossy sauce.
Stir the sauce into the samp and beans and simmer uncovered for 10 minutes so the flavours mingle and the liquid thickens.
Season with salt, then mash a few spoonfuls of the beans against the side of the pot to make it creamier.
Serve hot as a filling main dish, or alongside grilled meat or a leafy green relish.
